summaries.name: Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI)
summaries.summary: Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI) is required by lenders when a homebuyer puts down less than 20% of the purchase price, protecting the lender in case of default. It typically costs 0.3% to 1.5% of the original loan amount annually, added to the monthly mortgage payment. The user avoids PMI by putting 20% down ($68,000) on a $340,000 townhouse purchase.

summaries.name: FHA loans
summaries.summary: FHA loans are a government assistance program that can offer mortgage assistance to low-to-moderate-income homebuyers.

summaries.name: VA loans
summaries.summary: VA loans are a government assistance program that can offer mortgage assistance to low-to-moderate-income homebuyers, including veterans or active military.
